aiSummary.oneLiner: An open-source desktop client interfacing with the Claude Sonnet 3.5 API.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository provides a cross-platform desktop application designed to interact with the Claude Sonnet 3.5 model. It offers a clean, user-friendly interface for conversational AI interactions directly from the desktop. The application handles API key management securely within local storage. It features conversation history, code block syntax highlighting, and export capabilities. The project is built using web technologies wrapped in a desktop framework for wide compatibility. It aims to provide a native-feeling experience for users relying heavily on the Claude API.
keyFeatures: Native interface: Provides a dedicated desktop environment for interacting with Claude.
API management: Securely stores and utilizes user-provided API keys locally.
Syntax highlighting: Renders code snippets clearly with support for multiple languages.
Conversation history: Saves and organizes past interactions for easy retrieval.
Export functionality: Allows users to export conversations to Markdown or PDF formats.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This application is for developers and professionals who frequently use the Claude API. It is ideal for users preferring a dedicated desktop client over web-based interfaces. Content creators needing a reliable tool for AI interaction will find it highly useful.
